# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.5

This release restores a simple, production-safe update experience through
Project Control 2.0 and permanently protects customized RX Actions.

## Project Control 2.0

- Installs an official local ZIP or downloads the newest official release.
- Verifies GitHub SHA-256 checksums and both executable versions.
- Stops the NSSM service and creates a verified PostgreSQL backup.
- Captures before/after business-data fingerprints and refuses unexpected
  patient, RX, workflow, call, user, or configured RX Action changes.
- Preserves production `.env` byte-for-byte.
- Applies audited migrations, starts the exact release, and requires healthy
  application and database responses.
- Attempts paired application/database recovery when an update fails during
  downtime.

Existing `4.0.0-next.4` installations use the packaged
`INSTALL-PROJECT-CONTROL.bat` once; all subsequent updates run from the normal
`PROJECT-CONTROL.bat` menu.

## Workflow correction

Default RX workflow actions are now created only for an empty database.
Customized existing actions are preserved exactly, so explicit reference
initialization cannot add active steps and inflate Pending Deliveries.

There is no new schema migration. RX Softphone and the frozen 3.3.1 source are
unchanged.
